words.meaning: Blood relationship or a sharing of characteristics or origins, fostering a deep feeling of closeness and connection.
words.sentence1: They felt an immediate kinship when they shared their passion for art. (They felt an immediate kinship when they shared their passion for art.)
words.sentence2: A strong sense of kinship united the small community during tough times. (A strong sense of kinship united the small community during tough times.)

words.meaning: A state of deep quietness, peace, and tranquility of the mind and spirit.
words.sentence1: El sonido de la lluvia le trajo un gran sosiego al alma. (The sound of the rain brought a great peace to his soul.)
words.sentence2: Busco el sosiego en la naturaleza despues de una semana larga. (I look for tranquility in nature after a long week.)

words.meaning: The feeling of being calmed, pacified, or relieved from emotional distress.
words.sentence1: Un profond apaisement suivit l'annonce de la bonne nouvelle. (A deep sense of relief followed the announcement of the good news.)
words.sentence2: Il cherchait l'apaisement dans la lecture d'un livre inspirant. (He sought peace of mind in reading an inspiring book.)

words.meaning: A deep inwardness, warmth, and heartfelt intensity of emotion or affection.
words.sentence1: Sie umarmten sich mit großer Innigkeit vor dem Abschied. (They hugged each other with great warmth before parting.)
words.sentence2: Seine Musik drückt eine seltene Innigkeit aus. (His music expresses a rare heartfelt intensity.)

words.meaning: A bittersweet feeling of nostalgic happiness mixed with longing for the past.
words.sentence1: Ano uta wo kiku to natsukashii kimochi ni naru. (When I listen to that song, I feel a nostalgic warmth.)
words.sentence2: Kodomo no koro no omoide wa natsukashii desu. (The memories of my childhood are deeply nostalgic.)

words.meaning: A calm, peaceful emotional state free from disturbance or agitation.
words.sentence1: Dopo la tempesta, regnava una quiete immensa nella valle. (After the storm, an immense quiet reigned in the valley.)
words.sentence2: Ho bisogno di trovare un po' di quiete interiore. (I need to find a bit of inner peace.)

words.meaning: A profound sense of peace, tranquility, and emotional stability.
words.sentence1: Tā zài dàozhōng zhǎodào le nánzhí de ānníng. (She found a rare peace along the path.)
words.sentence2: Zhè ge xiǎo zhèn gěi rén yīzhǒng níngjìng ānníng de gǎnjué. (This small town gives people a feeling of peaceful tranquility.)

words.meaning: A state of calm, peaceful, and untroubled emotional serenity.
words.sentence1: Geuui maeumeneun ojik pyeongonman gadeukhaetda. (His heart was filled only with peaceful serenity.)
words.sentence2: Uri modu i pyeongonhan siganul oraedongan girokago sipta. (All of us want to remember this peaceful time for a long time.)

words.meaning: A comforting feeling of relief, emotional support, and rescue from distress.
words.sentence1: Komsar knong chet ban keunlaenh pteas muoy sangkroas. (Comfort inside the heart brought a soothing relief.)
words.sentence2: Akka nit samrab kar sangkroas arom thmey. (It is the time for refreshing the emotions.)

words.meaning: Peace of mind, tranquility, and freedom from worry or emotional agitation.
words.sentence1: Dit gee my groot gemoedsrus om te weet dat alles reg is. (It gives me great peace of mind to know that everything is right.)
words.sentence2: Sy soek na blywende gemoedsrus na die moeilike tyd. (She is looking for lasting peace of mind after the difficult time.)
